cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This concert was meant to bring the village together. Keep everyone facing the stage while I check the sound.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then start a song everyone knows, in unison. Please don't have the soloist competing with a silent amplifier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the chorus going until they return. Put them round the singers with the lights; don't count those seats as lost audience. They're our lighting crew now.

reason: B's torch solution broadens togetherness into singing and technical help, directed through actual concert expertise.
